title: Embedded Runge-Kutta formulae with stable equilibrium states
read_scope: All nine pages visually inspected: prior opening-page review plus pages 3-9 in this continuation.
findings: The Dormand-Prince family solution and error polynomials and coupled solution-step equilibrium matrix appear on page 27.
Computer search chooses pair coefficients for equilibrium stability; all three proposed methods are tabulated.
Figures 1-4 compare equilibrium spectral radius and absolute stability regions; the standard M pair has unstable sectors.
Section 3 uses a three-dimensional linear test with a dominant complex pair and compares rejected-step counts over 500 steps.
Page 32 states practical sensitivity to nonnormal dominant subsystems and error norms.
The inspected paper does not classify the selected long-lived real-coordinate clouds or their topology.
consequence: Neither adaptive-map formulation, unstable controller equilibrium, Dormand-Prince parameter search nor norm/nonnormality dependence is a novelty claim here. Exact-case historical priority remains open.
